name: channelconfig
description: Configures the channels where ProtoSeal can be used.

options.name: allow
options.description: Adds a channel to the whitelist.

options.name: unallow
options.description: Removes a channel from the whitelist.

options.name: channel
options.description: Channel to remove from the whitelist.

options.name: block
options.description: Adds a channel to the blacklist, including NSFW channels.

options.name: unblock
options.description: Removes a channel from the blacklist.

options.name: channel
options.description: Channel to remove from the blacklist.

options.name: clear
options.description: Clears both lists; NSFW channels remain allowed by default.
